great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: “Binge Refill ... provide for a refill of the Sum Insured, unlimited times during the Policy Year ... The Refill of Sum Insured shall be available for all subsequent claims also and to any Illness / Injury (including its complications) for which a claim has been admitted for the Insured Person during that Policy Year.”
great.explanation: The sum insured can be refilled unlimited times within the policy year for the same or different illnesses. This means you get extra coverage beyond the base sum insured without limit for repeated claims.

good.name: Initial Waiting
good.quote: “30-day waiting period ... Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident”
good.explanation: Illness treatments are excluded for the first 30 days except accidents, which are covered from day one. This is a standard waiting period protecting you from immediate claims.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: “Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with Us.”
good.explanation: Coverage for listed diseases and procedures starts after 24 months of continuous coverage. This is the market standard waiting period for specific illnesses.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.quote: “We shall cover the Medical Expenses incurred for the Insured Person’s Domiciliary Hospitalization, up to the Sum Insured as specified in the Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table of this Policy”
good.explanation: Treatment at home under certain conditions is covered up to the sum insured. This helps if you cannot be hospitalized but need hospital-level care at home.

good.name: Modern Treatments
good.quote: “We shall cover the Medical Expenses for the following modern treatment procedures ... up to the Sum Insured specified in the Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table of this Policy.”
good.explanation: Modern treatments like robotic surgeries and immunotherapy are covered up to the sum insured. This ensures access to advanced medical procedures.

good.name: Optional Covers
good.quote: “The following optional covers shall apply only if the premium in respect of the optional cover has been received and the Policy Schedule mentions the optional cover is in force...”
good.explanation: You can add optional covers like OPD, maternity waiting reduction, or non-medical expense waiver by paying extra premium. This adds flexibility without mandatory restrictions.

bad.name: Room Rent
bad.quote: “Room Rent ... up to the limits as specified in the Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table of this Policy;”
bad.explanation: Room rent coverage depends on limits in your policy schedule and is not unlimited or any room. If your schedule has a rupee/day cap, it may cause extra out-of-pocket expenses.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: “Non-Medical expenses ... As mentioned under Annexure (I) List II, III & IV will be excluded unless forms a part of In-patient hospitalization.” AND “Non-Medical Expense waiver ... We shall cover cost of Non-Medical Items ... listed under Annexure I ...”
bad.reference: Section D.23 Non-Medical expenses; Section C.IV (w) Non-Medical Expense waiver
bad.explanation: Many consumables and non-medical items are excluded by default and only covered if you buy an optional waiver. This can lead to unexpected out-of-pocket costs.

bad.name: Pre-hospitalization
bad.quote: “We shall cover ... for the number of days in accordance with the limits specified in the Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table of this Policy”
bad.explanation: The exact pre-hospitalization coverage duration is not stated and depends on your schedule. Lack of clear coverage means you may have limited or no pre-hospitalization benefits.

bad.name: Post-hospitalization
bad.quote: “We shall cover ... for the number of days specified in the Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table of this Policy”
bad.explanation: Post-hospitalization coverage duration is not specified here and depends on your schedule. This uncertainty may result in limited or no post-hospitalization benefits.

bad.name: NCB
bad.quote: “In the event of a claim impacting the eligibility of a No Claim Bonus, the accumulated No Claim Bonus shall be reduced by the percentage of Sum Insured as accumulated in the previous Policy Year...”
bad.explanation: The no claim bonus reduces after a claim instead of being protected. This means your bonus sum insured can decrease, reducing future coverage benefits.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: No explicit co-payment clause found in the provided extract (no statement like “co-payment of X% shall apply...” or “no co-pay”).
bad.explanation: Co-payment terms are not clearly stated in the extract. You should check your policy schedule or specific clauses to confirm if any co-pay applies.

unclear.name: PED Waiting
unclear.quote: “Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) ... shall be excluded until the expiry of months as specified in the Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table of this Policy...”
unclear.explanation: The waiting period for pre-existing diseases is not specified here and depends on your policy schedule. Confirm the exact duration to understand when PED coverage begins.
